patch.value: The steep direction (curvature 100) caps the learning rate: w1 is already near its stability limit (multiplier -0.9) while w2 (curvature 1) shrinks only 1.9% per step. Raising eta to 0.1 would make w1 diverge; the fix is to reduce the mismatch in curvature, e.g. by rescaling the parameters or features.
